old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-g4ia","title":"Include the routing dispatch byte in the maximum Announce payload","description":"P2 correctness: AnnounceMessage computes MAX_ANNOUNCE_WIRE_LENGTH as 254 - link_header(4) - signer(8) - signature(48) = 194 bytes, but Node.transmit_announce wraps every Announce with the one-byte L2 routing dispatch (0x15).
